paragraphs.text: translated by
1. Soma hath flowed for thee, Invoked of mat Speed to our sacrifice with both thy Coursers.
paragraphs.original: असावि सोमः पुरुहूत तुभ्यं हरिभ्यां यज्ञमुप याहि तूयम् ।
paragraphs.translit: asāvi somaḥ puruhūta tubhyaṃ haribhyāṃ yajñamupa yāhi tūyam |

paragraphs.text: To thee have streamed the songs or mighty singers, imploring, Indra, drink of our libation.
paragraphs.original: तुभ्यं गिरो विप्रवीरा इयाना दधन्विर इन्द्र पिबा सुतस्य
paragraphs.translit: tubhyaṃ giro vipravīrā iyānā dadhanvira indra pibā sutasya

paragraphs.text: 2. Drink of the juice which men have washed in waters, and fill thee full, O Lord of Tawny Horses.
paragraphs.original: अप्सु धूतस्य हरिवः पिबेह नृभिः सुतस्य जठरं पृणस्व ।
paragraphs.translit: apsu dhūtasya harivaḥ pibeha nṛbhiḥ sutasya jaṭharaṃ pṛṇasva |

paragraphs.text: O Indra, hearer of the laud, with Soma which stones have mixed for thee enhance thy rapture.
paragraphs.original: मिमिक्षुर्यमद्रय इन्द्र तुभ्यं तेभिर्वर्धस्व मदमुक्थवाहः
paragraphs.translit: mimikṣuryamadraya indra tubhyaṃ tebhirvardhasva madamukthavāhaḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. To make thee start, a strong true draught I offer to thee, the Bull, O thou whom Bay Steeds carry.
paragraphs.original: प्रोग्रां पीतिं वृष्ण इयर्मि सत्यां प्रयै सुतस्य हर्यश्व तुभ्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: progrāṃ pītiṃ vṛṣṇa iyarmi satyāṃ prayai sutasya haryaśva tubhyam |

paragraphs.text: Here take delight, O Indra, in our voices while thou art hymned with power and all our spirit.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्र धेनाभिरिह मादयस्व धीभिर्विश्वाभिः शच्या गृणानः
paragraphs.translit: indra dhenābhiriha mādayasva dhībhirviśvābhiḥ śacyā gṛṇānaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. O Mighty Indra, through thine aid, thy prowess, obtaining life, zealous, and skilled in Order,
paragraphs.original: ऊती शचीवस्तव वीर्येण वयो दधाना उशिज ऋतज्ञाः ।
paragraphs.translit: ūtī śacīvastava vīryeṇa vayo dadhānā uśija ṛtajñāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Men in the house who share the sacred banquet stand singing praise that brings them store of children.
paragraphs.original: प्रजावदिन्द्र मनुषो दुरोणे तस्थुर्गृणन्तः सधमाद्यासः
paragraphs.translit: prajāvadindra manuṣo duroṇe tasthurgṛṇantaḥ sadhamādyāsaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Through thy directions, Lord of Tawny Coursers, thine who art firm, splendid, and blest, the people
paragraphs.original: प्रणीतिभिष्टे हर्यश्व सुष्टोः सुषुम्नस्य पुरुरुचो जनासः ।
paragraphs.translit: praṇītibhiṣṭe haryaśva suṣṭoḥ suṣumnasya pururuco janāsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Obtain most liberal aid for their salvation, and praise thee, Indra, through thine excellencies.
paragraphs.original: मंहिष्ठामूतिं वितिरे दधाना स्तोतार इन्द्र तव सूनृताभिः
paragraphs.translit: maṃhiṣṭhāmūtiṃ vitire dadhānā stotāra indra tava sūnṛtābhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Lord of the Bays, come with thy two Bay Horses, come to our prayers, to drink the juice of Soma.
paragraphs.original: उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवो हरिभ्यां सोमस्य याहि पीतये सुतस्य ।
paragraphs.translit: upa brahmāṇi harivo haribhyāṃ somasya yāhi pītaye sutasya |

paragraphs.text: To thee comes sacrifice which thou acceptest: thou, skilled in holy rites, art he who giveth.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्र त्वा यज्ञः क्षममाणमानड् दाश्वाँ अस्यध्वरस्य प्रकेतः
paragraphs.translit: indra tvā yajñaḥ kṣamamāṇamānaḍ dāśvām̐ asyadhvarasya praketaḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. Him of a thousand powers, subduing foemen, Maghavan praised with hymns and pleased with Soma,-
paragraphs.original: सहस्रवाजमभिमातिषाहं सुतेरणं मघवानं सुवृक्तिम् ।
paragraphs.translit: sahasravājamabhimātiṣāhaṃ suteraṇaṃ maghavānaṃ suvṛktim |

paragraphs.text: Even him our songs approach, resistless Indra: the adorations of the singer laud him.
paragraphs.original: उप भूषन्ति गिरो अप्रतीतमिन्द्रं नमस्या जरितुः पनन्त
paragraphs.translit: upa bhūṣanti giro apratītamindraṃ namasyā jarituḥ pananta

paragraphs.text: 8. The way to bliss for Gods and man thou foundest, Indra, seven lovely floods, divine, untroubled,
paragraphs.original: सप्तापो देवीः सुरणा अमृक्ता याभिः सिन्धुमतर इन्द्र पूर्भित् ।
paragraphs.translit: saptāpo devīḥ suraṇā amṛktā yābhiḥ sindhumatara indra pūrbhit |

paragraphs.text: Wherewith thou, rending forts, didst move the ocean, and nine-and-ninety flowing streams of water.
paragraphs.original: नवतिं स्रोत्या नव च स्रवन्तीर्देवेभ्यो गातुं मनुषे च विन्दः
paragraphs.translit: navatiṃ srotyā nava ca sravantīrdevebhyo gātuṃ manuṣe ca vindaḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. Thou from the curse didst free the mighty Waters, and as their only God didst watch and guard them.
paragraphs.original: अपो महीरभिशस्तेरमुञ्चोऽजागरास्वधि देव एकः ।
paragraphs.translit: apo mahīrabhiśasteramuñco'jāgarāsvadhi deva ekaḥ |

paragraphs.text: O Indra, cherish evermore thy body with those which thou hast won in quelling Vrtra.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्र यास्त्वं वृत्रतूर्ये चकर्थ ताभिर्विश्वायुस्तन्वं पुपुष्याः
paragraphs.translit: indra yāstvaṃ vṛtratūrye cakartha tābhirviśvāyustanvaṃ pupuṣyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. Heroic power and noble praise is Indra yea, the song worships him invoked of many.
paragraphs.original: वीरेण्यः क्रतुरिन्द्रः सुशस्तिरुतापि धेना पुरुहूतमीट्टे ।
paragraphs.translit: vīreṇyaḥ kraturindraḥ suśastirutāpi dhenā puruhūtamīṭṭe |

paragraphs.text: Vrtra he quelled, and gave men room and freedom: Gakra, victorious, hath conquered armies.
paragraphs.original: आर्दयद्वृत्रमकृणोदु लोकं ससाहे शक्रः पृतना अभिष्टिः
paragraphs.translit: ārdayadvṛtramakṛṇodu lokaṃ sasāhe śakraḥ pṛtanā abhiṣṭiḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. Call we on Maghayan, auspicious Indra. best Hero in this fight where spoil is gathered,
paragraphs.original: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
paragraphs.translit: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |

paragraphs.text: The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.
paragraphs.original: शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम्
paragraphs.translit: śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām
